I have resolved the issue where the MySQL backend used deprecated `"db"` and `"passwd"` keyword arguments.

### Summary of Changes:
- In [django/db/backends/mysql/base.py](file:///testbed/django/db/backends/mysql/base.py#L202-L205), updated [`DatabaseWrapper.get_connection_params()`](file:///testbed/django/db/backends/mysql/base.py#L194) to use `kwargs['database']` instead of `kwargs['db']` and `kwargs['password']` instead of `kwargs['passwd']`.
